are both pages active. meaning i can go to either link and they will work

ChatGPT said:

Yes. Once you upload both HTML files to your physics-tools GitHub repository, both pages can be active at the same time.

You will have:

  • Original page:
    https://YOUR-USERNAME.github.io/physics-tools/

  • Chromebook 1366×768 page:
    https://YOUR-USERNAME.github.io/physics-tools/chromebook.html

They are independent. Adding chromebook.html will not replace or change your original page.

So you can keep the original version for students with larger screens and use the Chromebook version specifically for your 1366×768 machines.

One important point: the second link won't work until you've uploaded chromebook.html to the repository and GitHub Pages has published it. After that, both links should work independently.
